title: 第六千三百一十一章 邪龙往事第六千三百一十章 愿意认主
content_zh:
“很好，你是个聪明树。”
叶枫笑了笑，开口说道。
随后，永恒炬树苗便开始缩小，直接变成米粒大小，落在何楚楚手中。
“还请将我收入丹田。”
永恒炬树苗开口说道。
“好。”
何楚楚好奇的看着它，樱桃小嘴微张，将永恒炬树苗吸入腹中。
很快，何楚楚就感到丹田处有一阵痒麻之感传来，同时还有一段神异的规则纹路从她体内飘出，出现在她面前。
这规则纹路上刻印着玄妙字体，何楚楚看不懂，完全没见过，但她却能够清晰知晓这些文字的含义。
“天道契约……”
何楚楚口中呢喃。
所谓天道契约，便是由天道见证签订的契约，永恒炬树苗便是要和何楚楚签订天道契约，认何楚楚为主，日后两人生死相依，永不背弃。
“叶枫主子，我该怎么签订天道契约？”
何楚楚看向叶枫，她没接触过这么高端的事物。
“只要在心中确定即可。”
叶枫开口说道。
何楚楚闻言照做，顿时她的名字出现在规则纹路上，这规则纹路闪烁三下后便骤然消散，化作点点金光融入何楚楚与永恒炬树苗的体内。
此刻，何楚楚的丹田内，永恒炬树苗扎根在广袤无垠的丹田气海，周遭都是雄浑的灵气，它化作百丈高的大树，根须延伸到丹田的每一寸，这不单单是扎根，也是对丹田的一种保护。
有永恒炬树苗在丹田内，何楚楚的丹田防御力倍增，并且只要不是被瞬间摧毁，都能够快速恢复，可以说几乎是摆脱了被废掉修为的可能。
“主人，你丹田内的大地源气好充盈，我只需十年就能够成年！”

永恒炬树苗兴奋开口，它的声音在何楚楚识海中响起。
“那就好。”
何楚楚闻言也很高兴，一颗成年的神树，能够提供的帮助是无法想象的。
甚至可以说，一旦神树成年，何楚楚得到的好处也能够让她修为暴涨，至少也是达到灵皇巅峰，甚至成就灵帝都并非不可能。
“叶枫主子，谢谢你……”
何楚楚看向叶枫，眼神都有些拉丝了，感动无比的说道。
“这是你的机缘。”
叶枫淡然的摆摆手，他没有说谎，何楚楚能够得到地母的传承，让永恒炬树苗认主是很轻易的事情。
“大人，这远古邪龙魂我们该如何应对？”
永恒炬树苗解决了成长问题，便开始担心龙魂作乱了，连忙向叶枫问道。
“我带你们到他的心魔幻境内瞧一瞧。”
叶枫微微一笑，开口说道。
“什么？”
永恒炬树苗大吃一惊，这样的事情，就算是灵帝都做不到，叶枫却一副淡然样子。
content_en:
"Very well, you are a smart tree."
Ye Feng smiled and said.
Then, the Eternal Torch sapling began to shrink, directly becoming the size of a grain of rice, and fell into He Chuchu's hands.
"Please also take me into your Dantian."
The Eternal Torch Sapling said.
"Okay."
He Chuchu looked at it curiously, opened his little cherry mouth slightly, and sucked the Eternal Torch sapling into his belly.
Soon, He Chuchu felt an itching and numbness coming from her Dantian, and at the same time, a mysterious regular pattern floated out of her body and appeared in front of her.
There were mysterious fonts engraved on these regular lines. He Chuchu couldn't understand them and had never seen them before, but she could clearly understand the meaning of these words.
"Contract of Heaven..."
He Chuchu murmured in his mouth.
The so-called contract of heaven is a contract signed by the witness of heaven. The Eternal Torch Sapling wants to sign a contract of heaven with He Chuchu and recognize He Chuchu as the master. In the future, the two will depend on each other for life and death and will never abandon it.
"Master Ye Feng, how should I sign a heavenly contract?"
He Chuchu looked at Ye Feng, she had never been exposed to such high-end things.
“Just make sure in your heart.”
Ye Feng said.
He Chuchu heard the words and obeyed, and her name suddenly appeared on the regular lines. The regular lines flashed three times and then suddenly dissipated, turning into bits of golden light and integrating into the bodies of He Chuchu and the Eternal Torch Sapling.
At this moment, in He Chuchu's Dantian, the Eternal Torch sapling took root in the vast Dantian Qi sea, surrounded by powerful spiritual energy. It turned into a hundred-foot-tall tree, with roots extending to every inch of the Dantian. This is not only taking root, but also a kind of protection for the Dantian.
With the Eternal Torch Sapling in his Dantian, the defense of He Chuchu's Dantian is doubled, and as long as it is not destroyed instantly, it can recover quickly. It can be said that it is almost possible to get rid of the possibility of being destroyed.
"Master, the earth's origin energy in your Dantian is so full, it only takes me ten years to reach adulthood!"
The Eternal Torch sapling opened its mouth excitedly, and its voice echoed in the sea of consciousness.
"That's good."
He Chuchu was also very happy when he heard this. The help that an adult sacred tree can provide is unimaginable.
It can even be said that once the sacred tree reaches adulthood, the benefits He Chuchu will receive will allow her to skyrocket in cultivation, at least reaching the peak of the Spiritual Emperor, and even becoming the Spiritual Emperor is not impossible.
"Master Ye Feng, thank you..."
He Chuchu looked at Ye Feng, his eyes were a little drawn, and he said with great emotion.
"This is your chance."
Ye Feng waved his hand indifferently. He was not lying. He Chuchu could obtain the inheritance of the Earth Mother and it was very easy for the Eternal Torch Sapling to recognize its master.
"Sir, how should we deal with this ancient evil dragon soul?"
After the Eternal Torch sapling solved its growth problem, it began to worry about the Dragon Soul causing chaos, and quickly asked Ye Feng.
"I'll take you to the magical realm of his mind."
Ye Feng smiled slightly and said.
"What?"
The Eternal Torch Sapling was shocked. Not even the Spirit Emperor could do such a thing, but Ye Feng looked indifferent.
